name: Permiso de Residente Permanente como Casado con Panameño/a

requirements.blocker_text: Requires marriage to a Panamanian national, registered with Panama's Civil Registry, and proof of conjugal residence (lease, property deed, or utility bill).

Requires 2 years holding the initial provisional permit before applying for the permanent step. Submission of the application does not guarantee approval -- the National Migration Service retains full discretion.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate from the Civil Registry
Spouse's birth certificate and identity card
Notarized letter of responsibility and repatriation from the Panamanian spouse
Criminal record certificate and health certificate (provisional stage only)

outcome.duration_length: indefinite once the permanent step is granted

sources.title: Servicio Nacional de Migración de Panamá -- Requisitos, Casado con Panameño: documents for the permanent step following 2 years of provisional residence

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Panama's initial build. The fetched tier-1 document specifically describes the PERMANENT step (after 2 years of provisional 'casado con panameño' residence) -- the initial provisional-stage requirements themselves were referenced ('los requisitos anteriores') but not independently re-fetched and itemised in this pass; the provisional stage is treated as implicit rather than separately modelled. citizenship_after_months (36) reflects Panama's constitutionally reduced 3-year naturalisation track for those married to a Panamanian national (Article 10.2 -- see pa_naturalisation), distinct from and likely NOT stacked with the 2-year provisional-to-permanent wait modelled here; not confirmed whether the two clocks run concurrently or must be sequential.
